hero.title: Building tomorrow's leaders, one child at a time
hero.subtitle: Founded on the belief that every child deserves an education that nurtures curiosity, character, and capability — The Trium School is Nashik's newest K-12 institution built for the future.

vision_mission.vision: To be a centre of excellence where every learner is empowered to think critically, act ethically, and contribute meaningfully to the world.
vision_mission.mission: To provide a holistic, inquiry-driven education that blends academic rigour with life skills, creativity, and values — preparing students not just for exams, but for life.

items.title: Curiosity
items.description: We nurture a love of learning and encourage students to ask questions, explore ideas, and think beyond the textbook.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: We build character alongside academics — honesty, responsibility, and respect are woven into every aspect of school life.

items.title: Excellence
items.description: We set high expectations and provide the support every student needs to reach their personal best.

items.title: Empathy
items.description: We cultivate compassion and global awareness, helping students understand and appreciate diverse perspectives.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: We embrace new ideas and approaches, preparing students for a rapidly changing world with creativity and adaptability.

items.title: Community
items.description: We believe education is a partnership — between school, family, and society — and we invest in that relationship deeply.

leadership.heading: Leadership & faculty
leadership.subheading: Our team brings together decades of experience from leading schools across India, united by a shared passion for transformative education.

members.name: Dr. Priya Sharma
members.bio: With 20+ years in progressive education, Dr. Sharma has led curriculum reform initiatives across Maharashtra and is a TEDx speaker on child-centred learning.

members.name: Mr. Rahul Mehta
members.bio: A Cambridge-trained educator and former IB coordinator, Mr. Mehta oversees curriculum design and ensures our programmes meet international benchmarks.

members.name: Ms. Anita Desai
members.bio: Specialising in early childhood development, Ms. Desai brings warmth and expertise to our youngest learners, creating a nurturing foundation for lifelong learning.

cta.heading: Ready to be part of the Trium family?
cta.subheading: Admissions are open for the 2027–28 academic year. We invite you to visit our campus and experience the Trium difference.
